title: Agility course
description: One agility or jumping course: field, obstacle layout and performance sequence. The same format is used for digitized judge courses and generated courses. Version 1.0.

obstacles.description: Physical obstacles placed on the field. Each physical obstacle appears once, even if the sequence uses it several times.

sequence.description: Performance order from start to finish. Item 0 is obstacle number 1. The same obstacle id may appear more than once (e.g. a tunnel taken twice).

notes.description: Free-text notes, e.g. digitization uncertainties. Not used by the checker.

course_id.description: Pseudonymous id, e.g. 'C-J01-03' for corpus courses or 'G-C-017' for generated ones. Never contains the judge's name.

discipline.description: agility = agilityrata (contacts allowed), jumping = hyppyrata (no contact obstacles).

size_category.description: Size categories the course was used for; empty or omitted means all. Most courses are shared by all sizes; separate courses per size occur mainly in championships and open classes.

judge_id.description: Pseudonymous judge id from the consent log (corpus courses only).

year.description: Competition year only; full date omitted to reduce identifiability.

requirement.description: Task requirement given to the generator (generated courses only); kept so the checker can verify it.

condition.description: Test condition code, as defined in the study (e.g. 'C').

confidence.description: Overall confidence in positions: high = grid/measurements visible, low = estimated by eye.

obstacle_count.description: Required number of obstacle performances (length of sequence).

required_types.description: Obstacle types that must appear, with minimum counts.

field.description: Coordinate system: metres, origin at the top-left corner of the ring, x to the right, y downwards (same as image coordinates).

obstacle_type.description: SAGI obstacle types. hurdle = aita, spread = okseri, wall = muuri, tyre = rengas, long_jump = pituushyppy, tunnel = tunneli, weave = pujottelu, a_frame = A-este, dog_walk = puomi, seesaw = keinu.

id.description: Unique within the course, e.g. 'o1'. Ids are labels, not performance numbers.

placed_obstacle.description: Every obstacle except the tunnel: a centre point and a heading. Footprint dimensions come from the obstacle type (in the renderer and checker), not from the file.

heading.description: Direction of travel when the obstacle is taken 'forward', in degrees clockwise from +x (0 = to the right, 90 = down the field). For a hurdle the bar is perpendicular to the heading. For contacts, weaves and long jump, forward means entering at the end opposite the heading.

tunnel.description: Tunnel as a centre-line polyline from end A to end B. Length and curvature are computed from the path. Two points = straight tunnel.

obstacle.description: Id of the obstacle performed at this step.

direction.description: forward = along heading (or path A→B for a tunnel); reverse = opposite. Defaults to forward.

path_control.description: Optional point(s) (metres) the dog path from this obstacle to the next passes through, set by hand in the digitizing tool: one point, or a list of up to two points in travel order. Overrides the automatic shape of that gap.
